title: Assessment: Circle Area from Radius
description: Demonstrate mastery of direct area problems using A = pi r squared.

questions.question: A circle has radius 4 cm. What is its area using $\pi \approx 3.14$?
Which expression shows the exact area of a circle with radius 8 m?
questions.explanation: $r^2=8^2=64$, so the exact area is $64\pi\text{ m}^2$.

questions.question: A circle has radius 1.5 ft. Find its area using $3.14$ for $\pi$. Include square units.
The formula $A=\pi r^2$ means multiply $\pi$ by the radius squared.
questions.explanation: The exponent is on the radius, so the formula means $\pi \times r \times r$.

questions.question: A circular sticker has radius 6 mm. What is its area using $\pi \approx 3.14$?
A circle has radius 12 cm. Find its area using $3.14$ for $\pi$. Include square units.
If the radius is 9 m, the exact area is $18\pi$ m^2.
questions.explanation: The exact area is $\pi(9^2)=81\pi\text{ m}^2$, not $18\pi\text{ m}^2$.

questions.question: A circle has radius 11 in. Which answer has the correct value and units using $3.14$?
What is $r^2$ when the radius is 13 units?
A circle has radius 5 yards. Show the setup and final approximate area using $3.14$ for $\pi$.
questions.explanation: A complete answer shows the radius-squared step and square yards for the unit.
